title: ProvenancedValue
description: An extracted field value with spatial and confidence provenance.

value.description: Normalized value as string (monetary values are strings, never JSON numbers)

raw.description: Raw text as it appears on the document

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, present only for monetary values

bbox.description: Bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2] on the page, null if not locatable

confidence.description: Extractor-reported confidence; not a calibrated audit probability
